verdict.rationale: Circle's compliance OpenAPI documents a specific address-screening endpoint ("Create a screening request for a specific blockchain address and chain"), which covers wallet risk checks. Elsewhere, compliance is only mentioned in general terms: agent wallets have "built-in compliance guardrails" and the managed CPN tier says "Circle handles... compliance." Missing for 10: sanctions screening named explicitly, any travel-rule handling documentation, detail on risk scoring or screening outcomes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
